summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, reporting an additional closing under its February 11, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement. The company issued a senior secured convertible promissory note to Ascent Partners Fund LLC with a principal amount of $384,615.38, sold for $350,000, reflecting an original issue discount and a 7% annual interest rate. The note matures September 16, 2027, converts at $4.28 per share (floor $1.07), and includes a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. Monthly amortization begins January 1, 2027; 33% of subsequent offering proceeds must be prepaid. Watch dilution and delisting risk.
